**Neoadjuvant and adjuvant therapy.** The use of cisplatin-based neoadjuvant ChT for bladder cancer is supported by a meta-analysis of 11 randomised trials of 3005 patients [I, A] (HR 0.86, 95% CI 0.77-0.95), which translated to a 5% absolute increase in 5-year OS and a 9% absolute increase in 5-year DFS compared with cystectomy alone.<sup>52</sup> There is a lack of clarity about the optimal regimen.
